sentences.en: Yanni has been meeting up with his buddies every week.
sentences.zh: 雅尼每周都会和他的朋友们见面。

sentences.en: His drinking buddies had a hard time understanding all of this.
sentences.zh: 他的酒友很难理解这一切。

sentences.en: I'll never talk to you about my buddies again.
sentences.zh: 我再也不和你谈论我的朋友了。

senses.zh: 密友，好友；同伴，搭档；互相帮助的朋友
